title: Never receiving royalties for One O'Clock Jump
summary: Smith says he made up One O'Clock Jump with Basie at the Reno Club and never got royalties or even a credit.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Incidentally, the tune you're most famous for is "One O'Clock Jump."
Do you still get royalties from that?
I ain't ever got no royalties.
No, I didn't. I didn't even get a time.
Well, trust the man. You see, I made the number up... It was in the Reno Club with Basie...
